# The SmallCoder benchmark

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m evals.benchmark_manifest` — do not edit by hand. -->

Every suite below meets one validation contract, enforced by
`tests/` with zero model involvement: the fixture's own pytest suite
**fails** at baseline, applying **only** the declared reference fix makes it
**pass**, every reference anchor matches exactly once, committed fixtures are
never mutated by validation (checked by digest), and task ids are unique
across the whole repository.

Difficulty is characterized here by **objective proxies only** (size, file
count, whether reads must be paged). No frontier-model ceiling has been
measured yet; until one is, a 0-solve task cannot be distinguished from an
impossible one. That is a stated gap, not an oversight.

**95 tasks** across 6 suites:

| suite | tasks | median size | median .py files | multi-file GT | files >4KB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| design | 5 | 1,588 B | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| heldout | 8 | 1,905 B | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| m3_generalization | 12 | 1,584 B | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| ladder | 24 | 33,593 B | 18 | 7 | 11 |
| quixbugs | 24 | 1,512 B | 3 | 0 | 2 |
| realbugs | 22 | 513,789 B | 11 | 0 | 22 |

## design — 5 tasks

- **Provenance:** authored for this project (M1/M2 development)
- **Contamination:** clean when authored; published 2026-09 with this repository
- **Role:** development set for M2A/M2B — never held-out evidence
- **Size:** median 1,588 B (max 1,853 B) across a median of 3 Python files; 1 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 0 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## heldout — 8 tasks

- **Provenance:** authored after the M2B freeze
- **Contamination:** clean when authored; published 2026-09 with this repository
- **Role:** held-out for M2B; evaluation/design set for M3 (not held-out there)
- **Size:** median 1,905 B (max 2,884 B) across a median of 3 Python files; 0 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 0 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## m3_generalization — 12 tasks

- **Provenance:** authored and committed before any model run (preregistered)
- **Contamination:** clean when authored; published 2026-09 with this repository
- **Role:** independent suite for the M3 generalization study and the generic-loop control
- **Size:** median 1,584 B (max 2,123 B) across a median of 5 Python files; 0 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 0 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## ladder — 24 tasks

- **Provenance:** authored 2026-09, two size bands (~15KB and ~50KB, multi-file)
- **Contamination:** clean for every model trained before 2026-09; never previously published
- **Role:** makes repository size an independent variable; not yet run against any model
- **Size:** median 33,593 B (max 63,733 B) across a median of 18 Python files; 7 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 11 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## quixbugs — 24 tasks

- **Provenance:** imported from QuixBugs (MIT, public since 2017) by evals/import_quixbugs.py
- **Contamination:** ASSUME CONTAMINATED: classic algorithms, public for years — almost certainly in every modern model's training data. Valid for arm-vs-arm comparisons (both arms face identical contamination); NOT valid as an absolute capability measure
- **Role:** external anchor; relative comparisons only
- **Size:** median 1,512 B (max 11,392 B) across a median of 3 Python files; 0 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 2 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## realbugs — 22 tasks

- **Provenance:** mined from real repositories by evals/mine_realbugs.py; every fix commit merged 2025-01-01 or later
- **Contamination:** fix patches post-date the study models' training cutoffs, so the exact fixes cannot be memorized. The library code itself IS in training data — deliberately: that mirrors an engineer's model meeting a familiar library with an unfamiliar bug
- **Role:** real-world fidelity; not yet run against any model
- **Size:** median 513,789 B (max 825,222 B) across a median of 11 Python files; 0 task(s) need more than one ground-truth file; 22 contain a file over 4,000 B (forcing paged reads under the agent's output truncation).

## Licensing

Suites `design`, `heldout`, `m3_generalization` and `ladder` were written
for this repository (MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). `quixbugs` derives from
[QuixBugs](https://github.com/jkoppel/QuixBugs) (MIT) — see
[evals/quixbugs/ATTRIBUTION.md](evals/quixbugs/ATTRIBUTION.md). `realbugs`
snapshots real repositories at a pre-fix commit; each snapshot retains its
upstream LICENSE/NOTICE files, and per-task provenance (repo, commit, date,
subject) is recorded in the task spec and in
[evals/realbugs/ATTRIBUTION.md](evals/realbugs/ATTRIBUTION.md).
